narration: Think your mortgage is your biggest home expense? It's not even close. The real price tag on a house surprises almost every first-time buyer — and here's what nobody tells you.
visual: Dark background. House SVG slides up from bottom — triangle roof, rectangle walls, door, two windows. Text reveals: 'WHAT YOUR HOUSE REALLY COSTS?' with a blue accent question mark spring-bouncing in.

narration: Your agent never mentioned the one-percent rule. Every year, maintenance eats one to three percent of your home's value — up to $12,000 on a $400K house. And that's before anything breaks.
visual: Light background. House outline with a wrench overlaid. Progress bar fills from left with dollar counter ticking up to $12,000. Text: '1–3% OF HOME VALUE EVERY YEAR'.

narration: Property taxes and home insurance add another $5,500 a year before you pay a single repair. Most first-time buyers don't see these coming until the first bills land.
visual: Dark background. Two cards slide in from opposite sides — government building icon for property taxes ($3,700) and shield icon for insurance ($1,800). Both counters tick up. Total appears below.

narration: Seventy-seven percent of first-year homeowners face an unexpected repair. The average first-year bill is $5,400 — for something the home inspection missed.
visual: Light background. House SVG with a red crack/leak running down the wall. Alert badge pulses red. $5,400 counter animates up with '77%' stat spring-bouncing into view.

narration: Add it all up and a $400K home costs $3,500 a month — not the $2,100 mortgage you budgeted. That 66% gap is where first-time buyers go financially sideways.
visual: Dark background. Two horizontal bars animate outward — shorter grey bar labeled 'MORTGAGE $2,100/mo', longer blue bar labeled 'REAL COST $3,500/mo'. '66% MORE' badge spring-pops in.

narration: Before you buy, save $15,000 on top of your down payment for year-one hidden costs. Follow for more money truths your bank and your agent aren't mentioning.
visual: Light background. Piggy bank SVG bounces in. Three lines of advice stagger in one by one: 'BEFORE YOU BUY', '$15,000 CUSHION', 'BEYOND YOUR DOWN PAYMENT'. Blue follow CTA button pulses at the end.
